def cap(f):
    s=f.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=16:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],min(cols),max(cols),min(rows),max(rows)))
    return sorted(out)
def rblock(f):
    s=f.segmentation
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='r' and n['pixels']>5:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (n['pixels'],min(cols),max(cols),min(rows),max(rows))
    return None
print('start cap:', cap(current_frame), 'r:', rblock(current_frame))
# move down 9, right 9 toward N dot

for _ in range(9): action(['RIGHT'])
print('end cap:', cap(current_frame), 'r:', rblock(current_frame), 'lc:', last_action_result['level_completed'])
